text:
Priya Nair: Ping @Tom @Rajiv — Fraser Holdings (CFO + CISO) just escalated. They want answers today on egress limits for POC, IP retention language, and what price delta we need for a dedicated-capacity guarantee. CFO said "we need numbers before Friday" :eyes:
Tom Martinez: on it. which POC tier are they targeting — hosted or dedicated?
Priya Nair: Starting hosted, but they're asking if we can guarantee egress throughput for a week-long spike and whether that triggers a different SLA/pricing. CISO also flagged IP retention in the contract (they want model outputs persisted for 1 year).
Rajiv Patel: ok. quick facts: hosted POC can burst but no hard egress reservation. Dedicated gives reserved bandwidth and predictable latency. Pricing delta: reserved egress + dedicated GPUs = roughly +30-50% on unit cost depending on commit. I'll pull a concrete table.
Clare O'Connor: I can host a 30-min exec sync at 3pm today if that helps. Should we get Legal on the call?
Priya Nair: yes please add Legal. Mark (customer) prefers an exec-level readout not too technical. We need a single slide: 1) can we meet throughput? 2) price impact and options 3) IP/retention tradeoffs.
Rajiv Patel: prepping numbers now. Quick ask for @OpsBot: can we simulate a 1Gbps egress sustained for 24h in their region? If not, what's our safe upper bound?
OpsBot: simulation job queued: job_id=sim-179350-01. Estimated runtime 18m. Expected sustained throughput: 680-820 Mbps on hosted depending on concurrent prefixes. Dedicated pool can sustain >1.2 Gbps at current node counts.
Tom Martinez: Legal: what's the short answer on IP retention? can we accept 1-year retention of customer-generated outputs in Hosted? Any regulatory flags?
LegalBot: templated clause review: "Redwood retains logs and model outputs for 30 days by default. Extended retention (up to 12 months) available under enterprise addendum; requires customer opt-in and may increase data storage costs. No transfer of model IP to customer. Customer owns their input and output data subject to redaction obligations." Flag: if they request export of proprietary model weights or derivatives, we must deny.
Priya Nair: Good. Rajiv — can you produce a short pricing matrix (3 options: hosted baseline, hosted+reserve-egress, dedicated month trial) with estimated delta and commit terms? Need it by 2:30pm.
Rajiv Patel: I'll post a table in 10m. Preliminary: hosted baseline = $0.20/1k tokens (uncommitted), hosted+egress reserve = baseline + 35% storage/egress surcharge, dedicated trial (1 month, 2x gpus) = baseline * 1.45 + infra surcharge. Exacts in 10m.
OpsBot: sim-179350-01 complete. Observed sustained 790 Mbps for 24h window with 99th pct latency 87ms. If they need 1Gbps sustained, recommend dedicated pool or regional peering + burst reservation.
Tom Martinez: Noted. Clare, Legal: can we support 12-month retention under enterprise addendum? LegalBot said yes but storage surcharge applies. Any wording tweaks we need before sending to customer?
Clare O'Connor: I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum: retention window, encryption at rest, delete on termination, cost pass-through. Will circulate in 20m.
Priya Nair: Great. Schedule: 3pm exec readout if Legal and Rajiv can join. Action list: Rajiv — pricing matrix by 2:30; Clare — addendum draft by 2:40; Tom — confirm capacity path and fallback; LegalBot — prepare one-line summary of IP/no-weight-transfer. I'll set up 3pm invite and a single slide deck.
Rajiv Patel: pricing table posted — see snippet below:
```
Option A: Hosted baseline — no reserved egress. Cost: baseline. Pros/cons listed.
Option B: Hosted + Egress Reserve — +35% on token/unit cost, 99.5% egress SLO for bursts up to 800 Mbps.
Option C: Dedicated 1-month trial — ~+45% unit cost, reserved 1Gbps egress, SLA 99.9%, requires 1-month commit.
```
Tom Martinez: I pushed internal note: to guarantee 1Gbps we need dedicated pool + peering in their region. Capex ops: ~1 extra node per 500 qps.
Priya Nair: Thanks team. I'll send a succinct email to Fraser Holdings with the slide + addendum draft after the 3pm sync. If Legal signs off early, we might be able to accelerate a Friday-ish pilot start.
Clare O'Connor: Addendum draft posted to the thread (see drive link) :thumbsup:
LegalBot: Addendum draft: "Customer Opt-In Extended Retention Addendum v0.1" — includes retention window, encryption, deletion on termination, liability cap unchanged.
Priya Nair: Closing loop: 3pm exec call confirmed. Please keep replies terse — customer expects fast turnaround. :white_check_mark:
